{"id":1548642973,"question_id":344,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 5 months","timestamp":1739978171,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1548642973/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Reverse String","memory":"27.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    void recursion(vector<char>&s ,int i)\n    {\n        int n = s.size();\n        if(i >= n/2)\n        {\n            return;\n        }\n        swap(s[i] , s[n-i-1]);\n        recursion(s , i+1);\n    }\n    void reverseString(vector<char>& s) {\n        recursion(s , 0);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"reverse-string","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":355}
